01 — Consulting

Land & Habitat Consulting

Before a hunt happens, the land has to work. I walk your property, read the terrain, and build a habitat plan around what your ground can actually support — food, water, bedding cover, and a supplemental feeding program sourced through NXT Level Deer Supplements. The goal is simple: hold better deer, longer, on the acres you already own.

  • Habitat & terrain assessment, walked in person
  • Food plot design, placement, and rotation
  • Supplemental feed programs through NXT Level Deer
  • Water source and bedding cover planning

02 — Management

Property Management & Guided Hunts

Once the land is set up right, I can run it for you. I take on the day-to-day — habitat upkeep, herd monitoring, cameras, access — so ownership stops being a second job. Where it makes sense, I also outfit guided hunts on the property, turning it into a second income stream instead of just an expense line. You show up, you hunt.

  • Full-service property management
  • Ongoing herd & habitat monitoring
  • Guided hunts booked and run on your ground
  • An income stream for owners, not just an obligation
A guided hunt on managed ground.Full-service property management turns into real hunts — and real results.

03 — Partnership

South Africa Safaris

For clients ready to hunt Africa, I work directly with Buck Africa, a South African outfit I've partnered with to make sure the trip is handled right — from the animals on the list to the logistics of getting there and back. I consult on the front end and stay involved through the hunt, so you're never navigating an unfamiliar continent alone.

04 — Strategy

Draw & Points Strategy

The Western draw systems reward patience and punish guesswork. As an agent with Rolling Bones Outdoors, I build a personal points strategy across the states you want to hunt — when to apply, when to hold, and which units are actually worth waiting years for. I'm not doing this solo, either — a full Rolling Bones Outdoors team of application specialists and species experts works alongside me on the research and logistics, so nothing slips through the cracks.

1

Audit

Review your current point totals and hunting goals, state by state.

2

Map

Identify the units and species genuinely worth stacking points for.

3

Time

Build an application calendar so you're never applying blind.

4

Adjust

Revisit the plan each season as draw odds and regulations shift.
